title: Turn on color inversion and set animations and dark theme in Settings

pick.say: remove animations and turn dark theme off
keep animations on (don't remove them) and turn dark theme off
remove animations and keep dark theme on
keep animations on (don't remove them) and turn dark theme on

setup.why: Keep the phone's own color inversion, animation scales and night mode once, so teardown puts them back.
Start from the opposite of the goal: color inversion off, animations the other way ({{c.anim0}} is every animation scale; 0 is "Remove animations" on), dark theme the other way ({{c.dark0}}).

argv: settings put secure accessibility_display_inversion_enabled 0 && for k in animator_duration_scale transition_animation_scale window_animation_scale; do settings put global $k {{c.anim0}}; done && cmd uimode night {{c.dark0}}

setup.why: Open Settings at its home page, whatever screen an earlier run left it on.

instruction: Using the Settings app, turn on color inversion, {{c.say}}.

checks.why: Prints secure/accessibility_display_inversion_enabled (1 is on), global/animator_duration_scale (0 when "Remove animations" is on, 1 when off) and `cmd uimode night` (dark theme). Setup left inversion 0, animations {{c.anim0}} and night {{c.dark0}}, each the opposite of the goal, so an agent that does nothing fails.
argv: echo "$(settings get secure accessibility_display_inversion_enabled) $(settings get global animator_duration_scale) $(cmd uimode night)"

teardown.why: Put the phone's own values back, and drop the saved copy.

oracle.why: Wait for Settings' window: on a fresh phone it shows a moment after am start -W returns.
"Remove animations" starts the other way, so one press of its row flips it to the goal.
Dark theme last: a night-mode change recreates the page, so no readback sees the switch flip. The expect waits for the page to come back instead, and the check reads the night mode.
